validatedRules: All paths declared by the package manifest exist inside this package.
All nine character sprite sheets are 768x384 and match their manifest SHA-256 hashes.
All character action folders contain eight 192x192 transparent PNG frames.
All eleven core GIF previews decode to eight frames.
Every character action falls back to WORK_NORMAL.
Every effect track texture matches its manifest SHA-256 hash and frame dimensions.
The package contains no MP4 source videos, Seedance input images or submission locks.
